deadline.value: Applications are due by 11:59 pm Eastern on December 1, 2026.
deadline.quote: Applications are due by 11:59 pm Eastern time, Tuesday the 1st of December, 2026

gre_subject.value: GRE scores are not required for application or admission.
gre_subject.quote: Graduate Record Examination scores ARE NOT REQUIRED for application or admission to the Department of Biological Sciences Graduate Program.

supervisor.value: Ecology and Evolution applicants typically apply through a specific mentor; Molecular, Cellular and Developmental Biology students choose a mentor after first-year rotations, though contacting faculty is welcome.
supervisor.quote: if you are interested in the Ecology and Evolution Program, you would typically apply through a specific mentor

also.quote: you are of course welcome to contact faculty whose research you are excited about at any time during or after the application process

funding.value: PhD students receive full financial support (stipend, tuition waiver, health benefits).
funding.quote: Ph.D. students receive full financial support, including a competitive stipend, tuition waiver, and health benefits

entry_route.value: Apply from a bachelor's degree, or from a master's through the optional Advanced Level Entry route (needs a PhD mentor already agreed).
entry_route.quote: If you have a Master's degree or a Master's-level equivalent, you can optionally choose to apply for Advanced Level Entry (ALE).

notes: Two PhD programs: Ecology and Evolution, and Molecular, Cellular, and Developmental Biology. Applicants list four preferred faculty members.
